55279-latest-magic-being-original-conjur.title: Invented And Arranged
55279-latest-magic-being-original-conjur.creator: Professor Hoffmann
55279-latest-magic-being-original-conjur.description: A book by Professor Hoffmann. The little appliances to be presently described are the outcome of ideas which, after a long period of incubation in my note-books, have ultimately taken concrete form in what, I venture to believe, will be found to be practical and useful items of magical apparatus. I may further claim that they combine in an exceptional degree absolute innocence of appearance with a wide range of practical utility.

arxiv-1805-05491.title: Crowdbreaks: Tracking Health Trends using Public Social Media Data and Crowdsourcing
arxiv-1805-05491.creator: Martin Mueller, Marcel Salathé
arxiv-1805-05491.description: Abstract In the past decade, tracking health trends using social media data has shown great promise, due to a powerful combination of massive adoption of social media around the world, and increasingly potent hardware and software that enables us to work with these new big data streams. At the same time, many challenging problems have been identified.

arxiv-2210-12652.title: Implications of photon-ALP oscillations in the extragalactic neutrino source TXS 0506+056 at sub-PeV energies
arxiv-2210-12652.creator: Bhanu Prakash Pant, Sunanda, Reetanjali Moharana, Sarathykannan S
arxiv-2210-12652.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Bhanu Prakash Pant, Sunanda, Reetanjali Moharana, Sarathykannan S. Photon-axion-like particle (ALP) oscillations result in the survival of gamma rays from distant sources above TeV energies. Studies of events observed by CAST, Fermi-LAT, and IACT have constrained the ALP parameters. We investigate the effect of photon-ALP oscillations on the gamma-ray spectra of the first extragalactic neutrino source, TXS 0506+056, for observations by Fermi-LAT and MAGIC around the IC170922-A alert.

arxiv-2312-14608.title: Efficient Discrete Physics-informed Neural Networks for Addressing Evolutionary Partial Differential Equations
arxiv-2312-14608.creator: Siqi Chen, Bin Shan, Ye Li
arxiv-2312-14608.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Siqi Chen, Bin Shan, Ye Li. Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have shown promising potential for solving partial differential equations (PDEs) using deep learning. However, PINNs face training difficulties for evolutionary PDEs, particularly for dynamical systems whose solutions exhibit multi-scale or turbulent behavior over time. The reason is that PINNs may violate the temporal causality property since all the temporal features in the PINNs loss are trained simultaneously.

arxiv-2403-17608.title: Fake or JPEG? Revealing Common Biases in Generated Image Detection Datasets
arxiv-2403-17608.creator: Patrick Grommelt, Louis Weiss, Franz-Josef Pfreundt, Janis Keuper
arxiv-2403-17608.description: Abstract The widespread adoption of generative image models has highlighted the urgent need to detect artificial content, which is a crucial step in combating widespread manipulation and misinformation. Consequently, numerous detectors and associated datasets have emerged. However, many of these datasets inadvertently introduce undesirable biases, thereby impacting the effectiveness and evaluation of detectors.

arxiv-2502-00626.title: Lifting the Winding Number: Precise Representation of Complex Cuts in Subspace Physics Simulations Journal: TOG CCS: Computing methodologies Physical simulation
arxiv-2502-00626.creator: Yue Chang, Mengfei Liu, Zhecheng Wang, Peter Yichen Chen, Eitan Grinspun
arxiv-2502-00626.description: Abstract . Cutting thin-walled deformable structures is common in daily life, but poses significant challenges for simulation due to the introduced spatial discontinuities. Traditional methods rely on mesh-based domain representations, which require frequent remeshing and refinement to accurately capture evolving discontinuities.

arxiv-2506-13042.title: Laser ablated sub-wavelength structure anti-reflection coating on an alumina lens
arxiv-2506-13042.creator: Shaul Hanany, Scott Cray, Samuel Dietterich, Jan Düsing, Calvin Firth, Jürgen Koch, Rex Lam, Tomotake Matsumura, Haruyuki Sakurai, Yuki Sakurai, Aritoki Suzuki, Ryota Takaku, Qi Wen, Alexander Wienke, Andrew Y. Yan
arxiv-2506-13042.description: Abstract We used laser ablation to fabricate sub-wavelength structure anti-reflection coating (SWS-ARC) on a 5 cm diameter alumina lens. With an aspect ratio of 2.5, the SWS-ARC are designed to give a broad-band low reflectance response between 110 and 290 GHz.

pmc-10572641.title: Compositions and Antioxidant Activity of Tea Polysaccharides Extracted from Different Tea (Camellia sinensis L.) Varieties
pmc-10572641.creator: Kunyue Xiao, Yutao Shi, Sisi Liu, Yuqiong Chen, Dejiang Ni, Zhi Yu, Barry Parsons
pmc-10572641.description: Tea polysaccharide (TPS) is a bioactive compound extracted from tea. It has raised great interest among researchers due to its bioactivity. However, few studies focused on the diversity of TPS in its compositions and antioxidant activity. This study collected 140 different tea varieties from four tea germplasm gardens in China, and their TPSs in tea shoots were extracted.

pmc-10586178.title: Unusual Defect-Related Room-Temperature Emission from WS2 Monolayers Synthesized through a Potassium-Based Precursor
pmc-10586178.creator: Peter Walke, Reelika Kaupmees, Maarja Grossberg-Kuusk, Jüri Krustok
pmc-10586178.description: Alkali-metal-based synthesis of transition metal dichalcogenide (TMD) monolayers is an established strategy for both ultralarge lateral growth and promoting the metastable 1T phase. However, whether this can also lead to modified optical properties is underexplored, with reported photoluminescence (PL) spectra from semiconducting systems showing little difference from more traditional syntheses.

pmc-11313166.title: Autologous Fat Grafting (AFG): A Systematic Review to Evaluate Oncological Safety in Breast Cancer Patients
pmc-11313166.creator: Federico Lo Torto, Luca Patanè, Donato Abbaticchio, Alessia Pagnotta, Diego Ribuffo
pmc-11313166.description: Background: Autologous fat grafting (AFG) has emerged as a useful technique in breast reconstruction. Utilizing a patient’s own fat from areas like the abdomen or thighs, AFG serves various reconstruction needs. Nevertheless, the oncological safety of AFG in breast cancer patients has become a contentious issue.

pmc-12513080.title: Interdisciplinary approach in post-cardiac arrest anoxic brain injury with unconfirmed brain death
pmc-12513080.creator: Ahmad Abdelrehim, Daniel Landau, Carolyn Gaukler, Hari Brundavanam
pmc-12513080.description: BackgroundSevere anoxic brain injury after cardiac arrest can produce a clinical picture suggestive of brain death (BD). However, when ancillary testing, such as radionuclide cerebral perfusion scans (RCPS), shows preserved cerebral perfusion, the diagnosis of brain death cannot be confirmed, complicating end-of-life decision-making.Case summaryWe present a case of a post-cardiac arrest patient with profound neurological injury and absent brainstem reflexes.

pmc-13091170.title: Effects of Nonpharmacological and Nonsurgical Intervention for Lower Urinary Tract Symptoms in Parkinson’s Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
pmc-13091170.creator: Hiroyuki Ohtsuka, Mifuka Ouchi, Tomoko Otsuka, Takeya Kitta, Daisuke Yoneoka, Ryuji Sakakibara
pmc-13091170.description: Take Home MessageNon-pharmacological and non-surgical interventions may provide benefit for selected lower urinary tract symptoms in people with Parkinson’s disease, with the most consistent signal observed for urinary incontinence. However, confidence in effects varies substantially across outcomes and is limited by imprecision and between-study heterogeneity.

pmc-13462442.title: Development of a Nano‐Hybrid Composite Using Bovine Hydroxyapatite and Montmorillonite for Endodontic Applications—An In Vitro Study
pmc-13462442.creator: P A A S Prasad Kumara, Paul R Cooper, Peter Cathro, Henry F Duncan, Maree Gould, George Dias, Jithendra Ratnayake
pmc-13462442.description: AimHydraulic calcium silicate cements are widely employed in endodontics due to their excellent biocompatibility, bioactivity, sealing ability, and remineralisation potential. However, currently used products such as mineral trioxide aggregate (MTA) exhibit several limitations, including discolouration, cost, and poor handling properties.
